content.overview: Part XVIII of the Constitution provides three emergency mechanisms: National Emergency (Art 352), State Emergency / President’s Rule (Art 356), and Financial Emergency (Art 360). Following the 44th Amendment (1978) and S.R. Bommai (1994), emergency powers are subjected to strict parliamentary approvals and judicial review, while Articles 20 and 21 can never be suspended.
